DSSSB Assistant Teacher (Primary) Result 2026 – Full Details

Delhi Subordinate Service Selection Board (DSSSB) has released the Result for the post of Assistant Teacher (Primary). This recruitment was released for 1180 posts. Applications for the DSSSB Assistant Teacher PRT Recruitment 2025 were accepted from 17 September 2025, to 16 October 2025. The written examination was held on 16-23 February 2026, 26 & 31 March 206 and 03,10 April 2026. Candidates who had appeared for this exam can check their DSSSB Assistant Teacher (Primary) Result 2026 from the link given below

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 10 September 2025
  • Application Start Date : 17 September 2025
  • Last Date : 16 October 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 14 October 2025
  • Exam Date : 16-23 February 2026, 26 & 31 March 206 and 03,10 April 2026
  • Admit Card : 13 February 2026
  • Result : 13 October 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 100/-
  • SC, ST, Female : 0/-

How to Check Result

  1. Click on the direct official result link provided below.
  2. Enter your Roll Number / Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  3. Submit the form to view your scorecard on screen.
  4. Download and print a copy of the result for future reference.
